articles.title: WHY REDDIT'S INFLUENCE ISN'T GOING DOWN
articles.summary: Reddit influences product research and purchase decisions through peer recommendations and discussions that shape Google results and AI-generated answers, even without direct citations. Its organic traffic grew from 46M monthly visits in November 21 to 495M in October 26. An analysis of 58 clients found a median of 9% of LLM responses cited Reddit. Threads also shape buyer expectations through product comparisons and real-world feedback, which can influence third-party reviews and AI recommendations.

articles.title: TIKTOK QUIETLY LAUNCHES A STAND-ALONE TIKTOK SHOP APP
articles.summary: TikTok launched a standalone TikTok Shop app in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The app features livestream and video shopping, exclusive deals, and in-app checkout. The move gives TikTok Shop a dedicated shopping destination beyond its main social app and puts it in more direct competition with Amazon and Temu.

articles.title: SHOULD YOU INCORPORATE AI IN YOUR POSITIONING?
articles.summary: Companies have three ways to position AI in their product strategy. They can pivot into a new AI category when it offers stronger growth potential and solves a clear customer need; they can use AI to stand out in an established category, as Gamma does against PowerPoint and Google Slides; or they can keep their existing positioning and treat AI as a supporting feature. The choice should reflect what customers value rather than AI hype.

articles.title: WRITE TO THE CUSTOMER'S EXCUSE
articles.summary: Product copy should address not just why customers want something, but why they hesitate to buy it. Instead of repeating benefits and features, identify objections and use copy to overcome them. For example, a water bottle brand could acknowledge that customers already own one, then explain why they might want to replace it if it leaks or makes water taste metallic. Listing reasons customers might not buy can reveal opportunities to improve conversion copy.

articles.title: YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION UPDATES LINKED TO 359% RISE IN AI RETRIEVALS
articles.summary: Updating YouTube descriptions may improve video visibility in AI search. A Peec AI experiment found that videos with updated descriptions saw a 359% increase in daily AI retrievals, compared with 17% for unchanged videos. Retrievals also rose 293% in Google AI Overviews and 129% in AI Mode. The experiment updated descriptions on 15 of roughly 60 videos. Adding structured details and manual timestamps could help AI systems surface existing videos.

articles.title: A PRACTITIONER'S FIELD GUIDE TO MARKETING ENGINEERING
articles.summary: Marketing engineering uses technical skills to turn repetitive marketing tasks into automated systems. Instead of manually running campaigns, marketers build systems that continuously monitor market activity and identify opportunities. These systems can also produce and distribute content. The goal is to scale marketing efforts and run more experiments without adding headcount. AI coding tools make this possible without requiring a computer science degree.

articles.title: AI KNOWS WHAT YOUR BRAND DOES, BUT NOT WHO IT'S FOR
articles.summary: AI answers named a brand's ideal customer correctly only 60% of the time. Proof points like customer counts rarely appeared, and half of detailed brand descriptions included none. Where information was missing, engines often guessed, and 34% of answers contained an invented fact, most often a price. Positioning held up best when brands stated it simply and repeated it everywhere.

articles.title: WHAT IS AN AI AGENT FOR SEO? HOW IT DIFFERS FROM SEO TOOLS
articles.summary: Traditional SEO tools provide data and recommendations but leave execution to users. AI SEO agents go further by working across connected tools to complete tasks such as keyword research and performance reporting. They can run on schedules or respond to requests with limited human input. More advanced agents can manage entire workflows, but publishing and technical changes should still require human approval.
